acceptance_checks.description: A customer can successfully book an appointment
A staff-created appointment is owned by the customer, not the staff auth.uid()
Bookings persist and are re-readable from a fresh session
Authorization holds when checked from the wrong account
Cancellation works and meets the agreed notification requirement
Multiple appointments display per the agreed behavior
Announcements are visible in the app without push
Google OAuth is a verified working provider, not just a visible button
Push is actually delivered, not merely enqueued
Installed-iPhone PWA behavior on a real device
Mission records describe the current scope and hosting
